Package hadur117.core.move

Class SurfKeyRecord

java.lang.Object
hadur117.core.move.SurfKeyRecord
public final class SurfKeyRecord extends Object
SKEY-1: the surf-key record, one line per wave at the three-option surf's first rating of it, with the wave's point in the surf sample's feature space (FlattenerFormula; its first nine values are the MoveFormula point the hit views search on). With the ORC record of the same wave and the engine's truth log, the offline fit (data/tools/surf_key_fit.py) learns per opponent which key weights and kernel width explain that opponent's bullets best. Measurement only: a bench build turns it on, the competition jar never does, and nothing here changes what the surf does.

The line, after the SKN,round,tick, the duel puts in front: fireTime,power,firing, then the point's values.
